outcome: No verified public native EN/RU mixed-dictation control found; current user scenario unresolved

sources.finding: Apple describes dictation in the language of the keyboard and stopping with the dictation button. Does not document English/Russian code switching in a custom keyboard.
Bilingual keyboard guidance concerns typing for selected language pairs; not evidence of mixed EN/RU speech recognition.
English and Russian listed for Dictation and On-Device/Modeless Dictation separately. Multilingual Typing is a distinct QuickType section; no EN/RU mixed-dictation guarantee found.
One BCP47 identifier overrides plist PrimaryLanguage. Our EN/RU sets en-US or ru-RU; not multiple ASR language configuration.

codeReview.languageHint: primaryLanguage set on appearance and rebuild from EN/RU; default EN

inference: The supported public custom-keyboard configuration does not establish mixed EN/RU native recognition or control over native inline stop UI. Absence of documentation is not a universal claim about all ASR engines.
